name: Jeppes karakter
title: FBI Special Agent
description: Experienced field agent assigned to the Phoenix Field Office. Quiet and methodical, with a background in financial crime before transferring to violent crime.

name: Nicolais karakter
title: FBI Special Agent
description: Field agent with a prior military intelligence background. Pragmatic under pressure, though prone to fixating on details that don't add up.

name: Charles "Chuck" Brody
title: FBI Supervisory Special Agent — Violent Crime Squad
description: The agents' direct superior at the Phoenix Field Office. A 20-year Bureau veteran with deep local contacts and a blunt management style. Hands the agents the Dead Water case with minimal ceremony.

name: Margaret "Maggie" Vasquez
title: Detective — Phoenix PD Violent Crimes (South Mountain Precinct)
description: Twenty years on the Phoenix force, the last eight in violent crimes. Sharp and efficient, with an unconcealed scepticism toward federal involvement in what she considers local matters. Shared her case files on the canal disappearances without complaint, but made her views on FBI jurisdiction clear. Noted that Frank Tenorio and Angela Morales had both used the same shelter on W. Baseline Road.

name: Dr. Raymond Okafor
title: Associate Professor of Anthropology — Arizona State University
description: The leading academic authority on Hohokam material culture in the Phoenix area. Immediately identified the canal markings as modified Hohokam water-ceremony petroglyphs. Mentioned the 1964 Jessup report on the Sihu cult, apparently as an aside. Grew increasingly evasive as the interview progressed. Warned the agents not to go to the building on W. Southern Avenue — before they had told him they knew about it.

name: Earl Dutton
title: Federal Informant (inactive) — currently hospitalised
description: Long-term FBI informant who worked the south Phoenix area. A Vietnam veteran who has lived rough for most of the past decade. Disappeared after leaving a voicemail reporting something wrong near the canal; found ten days later walking barefoot on W. Baseline Road, non-verbal. Recovered partial coherence at St. Joseph's Hospital and described following a group into the canal area at night, ending up in cold water with no memory of how he got out. Insists the canal goes down.
